notes.title: HUGE DEMO UPDATE - LEADERBOARD + MORE
notes.content:
Astrobit Demo just got a huge update! 

Compete globally or against your friends with the new leaderboard! Test out new epic weapons, re-learn the game in the completely overhauled tutorial, play against bots that match your level with the newly added "difficulty" setting to the singleplayer mode!

Also fixed some bugs, like the bug which sometimes made you not able to use abilities or shoot.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Demo Update - Patch Notes 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a game breaking bug which made the game un-playable if you left during warmup and then joined back.
[*]Fixed a game breaking bug which sometimes made the ship not able to shoot or use abilities after a match was restarted.
[*]Fixed an audio bug which made the volume go to full if you dragged the slider completely down.
[/list]

[h2]Balancing:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Buffed “Canon” weapon:
* Higher base damage.
[*]Nerfed “SMG” weapon:
* Lower base damage.
[*]Buffed “Energy Beam” weapon:
* Increased the base damage, but decreased the damage multiply from the damage increase.
* Increased the time it takes before damage increase is reset.
[*]Buffed “Frost Touch” perk:
* Slow increased to 25%
* Cooldown per target decreased by 0.5 seconds
* Damage reduction reduced to 5%
[*]Nerfed “Agility” attribute:
* It now gives a bit less movement speed per point.
* It now has a cap for movement speed, after a certain level, you will only gain fuel if you keep upgrading it.
[*]Buffed “Charger” weapon:
* Higher base damage.
* Faster projectile speed.
* Higher “Destruction” scaling.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update - Patch Notes 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug which made you lose control over your ship if you disconnected and someone else joined before you reconnected.
[*]Fixed a bug which made deaths not reset when resetting a game.
[*]Fixed a bug which made the “You Won!” text stay the next game, even if you didn’t win that game.
[/list]

[h2]Balancing:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Nerfed “Attack Speed” attribute: 
    * Now gives 3.5% per level instead of 4%.
[*]Nerfed “Stagger Disk” ability:
    * It now stuns for 1.4 seconds instead of 2 seconds.
[*] Buffed “Nova Blaze” ability: 
    * It now deals a bit more damage
    * It now consumes a bit less energy.
[*] Buffed “Thunder Strike” ability:
    * It now has a faster cast time.
    * It now has a larger hitbox.
    * It now has a bit higher base damage. 
    * It now has a bit higher scaling with Destruction.
[*] Buffed “Fusion Beam” ability:
    * It now has higher base damage.
    * It now has a bit higher scaling with Destruction
[*] Buffed “SMG” weapon:
    * Increased base damage and base attack speed.
    * It now has a bit longer range
    * It now has a longer distance before damage drop-off starts.
[*] Buffed “Charger” weapon:
    * Increased scaling with Desruction.
    * Increased base damage.
    * Decreased the slow that is applied when you charge it.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update - Patch Notes 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a UI bug which made the main menu buttons not work and greyed out on ultra wide screens.
[*]Fixed a bug which made it possible to be stuck outside the map if the player used “Dash strike” at the edge of the map.
[*]Fixed a UI bug which sometimes made the shotgun cursor UI visible when it was not supposed to be visible.
[*]Fixed “Swirling Gash” indicator not being centered around the player.
[/list]
[h2]Balancing:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Buffed “Swirling Gash”:
    * It now has a bigger hitbox to deal increased damage. 
    * The non-increased damage has been increased by 30%.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update - Patch Notes 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a UI bug which made it impossible to upgrade a maxed out attribute after you restart a match.
[*]Fixed a UI bug which sometimes made the main menu buttons not work.
[*]Fixed an audio bug which maxed out the volume if you tried to mute the volume with the volume slider.
[*]Fixed a server region bug which made every user default to the EU region, even if the user played the game in a different region.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Huge improvement on how bots aim. Before, it felt like bots had aimbot, with instant lock-on on the target. Now, bots aim more like a real person. They now have what you can call an “aim speed”, plus a random aim offset to not constantly hit the target.
[/list]
[h2]Balancing:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Buffed the “Swift Spirit” perk. [/b]
     * The perk no longer reduces your movement speed.
     * -20% COOLDOWN  -> -25% COOLDOWN
     * -20 % ENERGY consumption -> -25% ENERGY consumption
[*]Levels give 5 HP per level instead of 7 HP per level.
[*]Players now get more star coins over time.
[*]Kills give 30 star coins instead of 40 star coins.
[*][b]Attack Speed attribute is nerfed.[/b] 
    * It now gives 4% per level instead of 5%
[/list]
